Notes: 6 x 1m so 2.8m spare against the 3.2m run. cut 800mm off four segments. link verified 2026-09-06 at 19.99, in stock, sold by muzata. replaces the vst v-channel at 39.99 which was also spec'd to only 10mm strip width. CAD: the corner rail clip is drawn for a 16x16 v profile, this is a 17x7 u profile so the clip needs re-dimensioning, and 17mm overhangs the 14mm rib by 1.5mm each side

Description: LY LIU YUN 12V 8.33A 100W ip67 potted led driver. aluminium case, moulded 3-prong cord. ce/rohs not ul

Notes: NO ul/etl listing, only ce/rohs. no user-serviceable fuse despite what this note used to claim. sealed ip67 brick with a moulded 3-prong cord so no exposed mains terminals. 100W is correctly sized: 54W strip plus 3 dosers at 4.8W = 68.8W, a 60W unit is undersized. decide on a certified alternative before energising

Description: Twippo 800pc / 50 set waterproof connectors 1 to 6 pin. 22-16 awg. ratchet crimper included

Notes: Set has 15x 2pin 8x 3pin 6x 4pin which covers everything with spares. Crimper included. Hookup wire is separate

Description: TUOFENG 22awg silicone stranded. 6 colors, 26.3ft (8m) each spool, 60 strand tinned copper

Description: MILAPEAK 16awg silicone stranded. 25ft black plus 25ft red, 252 strand tinned copper
